components.css: .ds-loop{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid var(--rule,#d9d3e0);counter-reset:step;font-family:"Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#16121c)}.ds-loop li{counter-increment:step;border-right:1px solid var(--rule,#d9d3e0);padding:20px 16px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;transition:background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-loop li:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-loop li::before{content:counter(step);font-weight:600;font-stretch:87.5%;font-size:1.75rem;line-height:1;color:var(--accent,#552583)}.ds-loop h3{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:700}.ds-loop code{font-size:0.8125rem;color:var(--ink-2,#4a4354)}.ds-loop li.is-active{background:var(--code-bg,#f4f0f8);box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 var(--spark,#fdb927)}.ds-loop li.is-next{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent,#552583)}

narrative.overview:
The site is the standards manual of the sparc way of working. Each page is a technical drawing sheet: a white sheet, ink, hairline rules, a 12-column grid, a title block and numbered addresses. The first viewport (the header "field") shows a faint 24px drawing grid. All other parts are a plain sheet.

The page is minimal and quiet. Color has a job, not a mood. Purple marks addresses and links. Gold marks the current step. Depth comes from rules and frames, not from shadows. The site refuses the dark dev-tool page with a glowing terminal hero and a row of feature cards.

The sheet follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Dark mode changes the token values only. The structure does not change. The product facts are in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) and the [README](README.md).
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules (1px) frame each block. Square corners everywhere except the logo mark.
A strict 12-column grid with a 24px column gap.
One self-hosted variable face (Archivo): semi-condensed bold for headings, regular for body.
Numbered section addresses (1.0, 2.0, ...) in the masthead index and before each section heading.
The change loop steps with the scroll position. The active frame gets a gold bar. The next frame gets a purple outline.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Purple marks where you are in the manual. Gold marks only the logo spark and the active loop step. Do not add other gold.

rules.name: The Ink Link Rule
rules.body: Links in the masthead index, the title block and the footer are ink. All other links are purple.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Use only Archivo and the system monospace. Change width and weight, not the family.

rules.name: The Number Address Rule
rules.body: A section address is a number in its own grid column. It is never a word.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate blocks with 1px rules and frames. Do not lift them with shadows.

dos: Do frame each block with 1px Hairline rules and keep corners square.
Do put content on the 12-column grid, with the address in columns 1 to 2.
Do use purple only for the top rule, links, addresses, step numbers, the title block head and the next-step outline.
Do use gold only for the logo spark and the active loop step bar.
Do show focus with the ink ring and the sheet gap.
Do remove motion and smooth scroll when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
Do self-host all assets. Send no external requests and set no cookies.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, gradients or glow.
Don't use a dark terminal hero or a row of feature cards.
Don't put the drawing grid outside the header field.
Don't put an uppercase word above a heading. The address before a heading is a number only.
Don't use icon glyphs. Draw marks with borders or inline SVG.
